semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Gravitational microlensing is a specific case of gravitational lensing. Both involve the bending of light due to gravity, but microlensing usually refers to small or isolated deflections by a single star, whereas lensing can refer to more massive objects like galaxies. Nevertheless, they belong to the same conceptual phenomenon.
